Market today: The market's feeling a tug-of-war. Rising 10-year Treasury yields are a real headwind for your tech and growth stocks, making future earnings look less appealing. But on the flip side, strong demand for AI servers is a clear tailwind for the chip sector.

Your holdings: SOXL (-58.39%) and SPAL (-38.05%) are in dire straits. These leveraged ETFs decay and their deep losses are amplified by margin. QQQ (-0.98%), SMH (-14.32%), and QQQI (-4.29%) are all on 'TRIM' status, signaling caution.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields; continued increases will pressure your tech names. Also, monitor AI demand news for potential boosts to your chip holdings.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged losers, especially with rising yields creating headwinds for your concentrated tech book.
plays: Cut SOXL immediately; its -58.39% loss and leveraged decay are a critical risk on margin.
Re-evaluate SPAL's stop at 21.38; this leveraged ETF is down -38.05% and decays, demanding attention.
Consider adding to CRWD at 214.17-213.80, stop 212.84, given its strong performance and scanner 'ACCUMULATE' signal.
